en.label: People who are blind and use a screen reader
en.description: Hear the page read aloud, or read it on a braille display, and move around by keyboard or gestures.

en.label: People with low vision
en.description: Enlarge text, zoom the page or use a magnifier, and need strong contrast.

en.label: People with colour blindness
en.description: Cannot rely on colour alone to tell things apart, such as red and green.

en.label: People who are deaf or hard of hearing
en.description: Need captions or a transcript to follow anything spoken or heard.

en.label: People who can't use a mouse (keyboard, switch or voice control)
en.description: Move through the page with the keyboard, a switch device or spoken commands.

en.label: People with limited hand movement or tremor
en.description: Find small targets, dragging and fast or precise actions hard.

en.label: People with cognitive or learning disabilities
en.description: Find complex wording, memory load, time limits and surprises hard.

en.label: People sensitive to flashing or motion
en.description: Flashing can trigger seizures; on-screen motion can cause dizziness or nausea.

screen_reader.name: Screen reader
screen_reader.meaning: Software that reads the screen aloud, or shows it on a braille display, so people can use a computer or phone without seeing it.

braille_display.name: Braille display
braille_display.meaning: A device that shows text as raised dots under the fingertips.

magnifier.name: Screen magnifier
magnifier.meaning: Software that enlarges part of the screen many times over.

browser_zoom.name: Browser zoom
browser_zoom.meaning: Enlarging the whole page, for example with Ctrl and +.

voice_control.name: Voice control
voice_control.meaning: Software that lets people click, type and scroll by speaking, for example by saying the words on a button.

switch_device.name: Switch device
switch_device.meaning: One or two large buttons that step through items on screen, used by people with very limited movement.

keyboard_navigation.name: Keyboard navigation
keyboard_navigation.meaning: Moving through links and buttons with the Tab, arrow and Enter keys, without a mouse.

captions.name: Captions
captions.meaning: On-screen text of what is said in a video, and of important sounds.

audio_description.name: Audio description
audio_description.meaning: A narrated track that describes important visual details of a video.

transcript.name: Transcript
transcript.meaning: The full text of a video or audio recording.

high_contrast.name: High-contrast mode
high_contrast.meaning: A device setting that replaces a site's colours with a few strong ones.

reduce_motion.name: Reduce motion setting
reduce_motion.meaning: A device setting that asks websites to limit animation.
